messages:
Elaine Ng: quick heads-up 1: we need to finalize owners for the keystore/HSM evidence and the audit-log backfill before the audit kickoff next Tue. who can take attestation sign-off?
Omar Patel: I can lead the HSM attestation draft. need an ops contact for vendor access windows and someone to sign the runbook. tagging @vendor-ops in case they have availability constraints.
Mike R.: FYI I spotted a schema mismatch in audit-forwarder tests this morning. opening a hotfix branch; will ping eng-infra for a quick review.
Tara S.: Evidence bucket created in staging: redwood-evidence-stg. Retention set to 365d. Need confirmation from sec on manifest fields for key-rotation metadata.
Jun Li: For backfill, proposing a deduping 7-day window job with manifest output and checksums. I can author the job, but who owns scheduling/alerts?
Elaine Ng: Assignments proposal: Omar = HSM attestation + vendor coord, Jun = backfill job + manifest schema, Tara = artifact packaging & upload, Mike = CI/infrastructure fix. I'll own the entrance checklist and consolidate artifacts.
Omar Patel: ack. I'll put the attestation template in confluence and request the vendor access slot. ETA EOD today.
deploy-bot: CI alert: infra/audit-forwarder failed unit tests at 2026-03-12T08:42Z. Failure: schema v2 mismatch on event.meta.source. https://ci.redwood/pipe/infra-audit/789 :warning:
Mike R.: Hotfix PR opened (internal PR 2209) to fix schema mismatch. tagging @eng-infra for review; small change.
Tara S.: Proposed artifact naming: soc2-<control>-<env>-YYYYMMDD. example: soc2-AC-stg-20260315. Also planning PDF bundles + manifest.json with SHA256 checksums. OK?
Elaine Ng: looks good. Keep env values limited to prod/stg/nonprod. Keep each control bundle <= 50MB.
Jun Li: sample command i'll include in PR: `python ops/backfill.py --start 2026-03-08 --end 2026-03-14 --dry-run`. manifest will include checksum and object path.
sec-audit-bot: Audit slot reserved: 2026-03-16 09:00-12:00 UTC. Deadline: upload all artifacts by EOD 2026-03-15.
vendor-ops: tentative vendor access window OK, but we need the final runbook and service account 24h before the slot.
Omar Patel: noted, will request ephemeral scoped token for vendor and share runbook link once ready.
Mike R.: CI fixed and merged; main is green now. I'll monitor next runs and post to #eng-sre if anything flakey shows up. :tada:
Tara S.: I'll produce per-control PDF bundles + manifest.json. Will place pointers in confluence index page and upload to redwood-evidence-stg.
Elaine Ng: outstanding checklist (owners): HSM attestation - Omar; backfill + manifest - Jun; artifact packaging/upload - Tara; CI/schema fixes - Mike. I'll do a final sweep 2026-03-15 morning and post consolidated package. ping me for blockers. :heavy_check_mark:
